opinion.headline: Acquired new tastes & distastes: India’s health warnings are loud. Its consumption habits are louder

opinion.headline: The not-so-great visa wall of China: Why Indian business is stuck
opinion.hook: China's security focus is now restricting Indian business visas, impacting economic ties.
opinion.summary: India eased investment rules, and China tightened its security matrix afterward. Indian executives face visa hurdles, affecting on-site supplier visits for procurement needs.
